title: Ranking Google's Free AI Lessons Until I Find the Best One
description:
Google launched AI Boost Bites, a free set of under 10 minute videos where Google's own AI experts teach advanced prompting, Gemini Gems and NotebookLM for research, and you earn an official Google skill badge you can add to your CV, LinkedIn or Upwork profile. The free guide below has every direct lesson link, the best order to watch them in, and how to claim and display the badge.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BEwIQe9kU82mJBZntMnpyxber3gPQF8N0eA0pX3lRlU/edit?usp=sharing
